records.choice: New guide-voice narration built on the SOA-01 pattern: per-line TTS (speed 115, the lane's measured pace), speech-span trims on a gap timeline, the synthesized lane bed, mixed and mastered through the QC A-08 chain to ≈ −14 LUFS / TP ≤ −1, wrapped with the container intro/outro from WAV sources and encoded to AAC exactly once at render (A-09). A music-only twin programme (identical splice/timing) is kept for the voice-clone swap.
records.alternatives: Reusing SOA-01's bed recording or a library track — rejected: the bed is synthesized per piece from the same recipe so length and chord quarters fit the piece.
records.context: build_soa01.py is the lane's reference build; the cloned-voice ladder swaps narration via the twin when Hadi's clone lands.
records.why: Audio architecture is a lane constant, not a per-piece experiment.
records.change: The voice-clone pass (narration swap via the twin).

records.choice: Words pop into the planned empty lower band (centres y=1290/1410, alternating), centred at x=530, DejaVu Sans Bold 62px, chalk; key words amber with an overshoot pop. No plate, no band, no subtitle line anywhere in the DOM.
records.context: QC V-16 + V-14 safe rect; the lane's v3 scenes (WD-01/SOA-01) set this grammar.
records.why: The lower third is empty in every scene by design — words live in the picture's negative space, timed to speech.
records.change: If a future scene's art fills the lower band, the bands move per-scene (DR per piece).

records.choice: Phrases of at most 3 words; EVERY phrase group's rendered width is asserted at build time (PIL measurement of the embedded font) at ≤840px, and re-verified on rendered frames at QC. A failed assert stops the build.
records.alternatives: Trusting the layout (the i2/i1 overflow failure mode in this lane's history).
records.context: Final QC defect D-1 (2026-10-23) — the fix belongs in the template, not one piece's numbers.
records.why: A recurring defect indicts the workflow (R-03).
records.change: Nothing relaxes this; a wider group needs a smaller font, never a wider rect.

records.choice: faster-whisper word timestamps on the piece's voice track, script words mapped via difflib (fastlane-v3 align method, repairs logged in words.json); words arrive cumulatively inside a phrase, and a completed phrase HOLDS while the next phrase reveals, clearing when the phrase after next starts (C-05 carry-over via the shared fastlane-v3 phrases_for, JOB DWELL-CONTRAST-FIX 2026-10-25).
records.alternatives: Whole-line captions (banned) and per-word karaoke over a standing line (a line on screen = subtitle).
records.context: QC V-16 timing rule; SOA-01 v3 alignment method; QC C-05 dwell floor (MEASURE-SWEEP 2026-10-25).
records.why: At most two phrases exist at any instant, in alternating bands; every word still arrives exactly with its spoken moment.
records.change: Whisper boundary error >~150 ms on a re-alignment.

records.choice: Role: APPLY — the Academy ownership doctrine applied to one dated survey (Stack Overflow 2025). Payoff schedule (H4): adoption lands first (L2), velocity doubles it (L3), the turn is the SAME survey's second number at L4 (46% distrust), distrust is converted into labour at L5 (the hand-check; the three missing compartments named as absences), and L6 collects the list into one word — 'the layer' — as the close. The spoken ask (L7) and the bridge then spend the conviction the payoff earned. Objective (catalogue, GROUNDED): "Show developers adopted AI fastest yet distrust it most, verifying by hand what no trustworthy layer checks."
records.alternatives: INTRODUCE (teach the ownership doctrine from zero) — rejected: that is the Toaster song's and Lesson 1's job; this lane reports a fact and applies the doctrine.
records.context: STRUCT-2's SOA-01 findings transferred: H5 weak (role unrecorded) and H4 weak (schedule unrecorded) — this record closes both for this piece at build time.
records.why: An unrecorded role drifts: the next SoA piece inherits the stance only if it is written down.
records.change: A lane-level ruling that SoA pieces teach rather than report.

records.element: End referral — bridge card after the spoken ask (H6 / HS-06)
records.choice: A bridge compartment after the spoken L7 ask (no narration over the card; the bed carries under it — CB-01), AFTER the ask's hold (content_end → +2.015s), IDENTICAL on every SOA piece (SOA-FIX lane standard): NEXT signpost → 'Renters can become owners.' → toaster symbol → 'WHO OWNS THE TOASTER?' → 'the song that asks who owns the layer' → 'tap to watch →'. Target: 'Who Owns the Toaster?', the funnel long-form. T-18: the title is never dropped bare — the same card says what it is (a song) and what it asks.
records.alternatives: (a) Dropping the script's spoken L7 ask because SOA-01 has none — rejected: the script is locked and its L7 does a different job (the N-09 channel ask, spoken, in the piece's own words) than the card (the HS-06 referral to the funnel piece). Both stay; the card comes after the ask's hold, so neither crowds the close. (b) Description/pinned-comment link only — rejected: it routes nobody from inside the piece (the STRUCT-2 H6 finding on SOA-01).
records.context: SOA-FIX (2026-10-24) made this card the lane standard after STRUCT-2 found H6 RANDOM-ABSENT on SOA-01. Funnel ruling: Toaster + Doorway are THE FUNNEL; shorts are judged by onward movement into them.
records.why: The objective ends at ownership; a viewer the close convinces is owed the route to the ownership teaching at the exact moment of conviction.
records.change: Funnel evidence (onward movement from this piece) at the 48-h scoreboard.

records.element: Visual grammar — two counters, one card; labour performed
records.choice: Per the script's §7 note: the adoption counter jumps 44% → 84% (L3), the trust number lands as a second, amber counter from the SAME survey card (L4), L5 performs the hand-check as stamps landing on code lines, and L6 sets the adopted model beside three dashed, empty compartment outlines (memory / instructions / checks).
records.alternatives: A trust 'gauge' graphic — rejected: the piece's credibility move is two comparable numbers from one source, not a dial.
records.context: The script's §7 visual template note is the design source; H7 (visual story performs the narration) is the governing class.
records.why: The visual grammar is the piece's argument made visible, chosen with the script — not decoration added at build.
records.change: Retention evidence against a beat at the 48-h scoreboard.

records.element: Structure records (HS) — what the build closes
records.choice: The script's Section N gate stands (N-01–N-09 PASS, logged in the script doc). This build adds the records STRUCT-2 found missing on the lane's built piece: the H5 role + H4 payoff schedule (DR-ROLE) and the H6 end referral (DR-BRIDGE). H3 orientation: the dateline orients the lane and the date — the lane's sanctioned format device, logged in every SOA script (§6 anti-signature scan) — and the takeaway orientation is carried by L2's fact plus the turn headline; no extra orientation line is added because the scripts are locked verbatim (DR-SCRIPT).

records.context: STRUCT-2 reaudit of SOA-01 v3 (H3 W, H4 W, H5 W, H6 R) + SOA-FIX's closure pattern.
records.why: Records are how the next piece inherits the lane's decisions instead of re-deriving them.
records.change: Hadi's verdict on this piece's board review.
